about: Who may sign a box release artifact manifest (flagship/box-artifact/v1). Pre-GA this is the single maintainer holder key that also signs release endorsements (.maintainers/); plan section 8.3 replaces it with a distinct release track and a 2-of-N threshold before general availability. A test fails if a key here is not a current holder in .maintainers/keys. Raising the threshold or rotating a key means changing this file in Studio, the apps and the boxes' installer together.
